Du hast deine HZB im Ausland erworben? Prüfung und Anerkennung deines Zeugnisses über uni-assist (Vorprüfungsdokumentation - VPD).

note.fr: Dans le système bavarois, une HZB étrangère (par ex. le Bac marocain) ne donne pas automatiquement accès à l'université : la reconnaissance par uni-assist détermine si un Studienkolleg ou des années d'études supplémentaires sont nécessaires.
note.en: In the Bavarian system a foreign HZB (e.g. the Moroccan Baccalauréat) does not automatically grant university access: uni-assist recognition determines whether a Studienkolleg or additional study years are needed.

notes: Tuition: both quotes state a 500 EUR per semester service fee for non-EU students of International Engineering (due from winter semester 2025/2026), but this is the only EG/EEA/tuition-like fee mentioned. There is no quote stating a tuition fee for this applicant beyond that amount; no quote giving zero tuition fees for non-EU students was found. Intake: no date could be assigned because the deadline quotes either carry a specific year tied to a past cycle or belong to all bachelor programmes without naming non-EU/foreign applicants; 31 August is used as recurringDeadline as stated for international applicants at this programme in the DAAD database. applicationChannel: the programme page states the application is made online via MeinCampus (university's own portal). uni-assist is used for the preliminary review of the diploma (VPD), but the application itself is made directly to the university; the page does not state that international applicants apply through uni-assist. A quote stating the application channel specifically for international applicants could not be found. Documents: the quoted items come from a page about "international applicants" in general; translation requirement not stated.
